seasons.description: All-out war has arrived in Westeros, and the internet is absolutely losing its mind.
seasons.overview: The Black and Green factions lock into an all-out, relentless struggle for the Iron Throne. As dragons and armies clash across the realm, Westeros witnesses the devastating consequences of total war.

seasons.description: Javier Bardem's bone-chilling thriller just dropped its finale, and the tension is unmatched.
seasons.overview: A storm is coming for two happily married attorneys when a notorious killer from their past gets out of prison.

seasons.description: The dark, retro Gotham adventure you've been waiting for just returned to Prime Video.
seasons.overview: The Batman and his allies rally together to dismantle Rupert Thorne's criminal enterprise. But dethroning a reigning crime boss comes at a high price.

seasons.description: This high-stakes zombie spinoff is currently dominant on AMC and trending on social media.
seasons.overview: In season three, Maggie and Negan finally put aside their differences to build the first thriving community in Manhattan since the apocalypse, but when chaos in the city begins to arise, they are forced to question: have they learned from their old wounds or will their dark past spell doom for the entire city?

seasons.description: Sci-fi at its absolute peak—prepare for amazing adventures and incredible, fan-favorite surprises.
seasons.overview: In the fourth season, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise—led by Captain Christopher Pike—embarks on a series of thrilling and emotional adventures across the stars. As they journey to strange new worlds, they battle inner demons and external threats, encounter colorful new characters, reunite with familiar faces and confront terrifying aliens. Through it all, they strive to embrace a bright, hopeful future.

seasons.series_name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
seasons.description: The wild, multiverse-bending sitcom spinoff that has the internet arguing about nerd culture.
seasons.overview: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

seasons.description: TikTok's favorite high-octane Korean thriller is back with even more insane action choreography.
seasons.overview: Season 2 returns with Jian in control of the weapons shop, Jinman returned from the dead, and BABYLON well and truly on the backfoot. Working to keep Jian safe, Jinman will take the fight to BABYLON's door, but the mercenary organization won't go down easily. Humiliated, BABYLON will bring in help from overseas and unleash a new wave of deadly assassins to rebuild their ranks and exact their revenge.

seasons.description: This dystopian mystery is currently keeping viewers on the edge of their seats weekly.
seasons.overview: Season three reveals an origin story set centuries earlier, while continuing the saga of a dystopian society of 10,000 people living underground under mysterious circumstances. In the present, Juliette Nichols survives her forced "cleaning" but returns with memory loss as the silo recovers from rebellion and faces a dangerous new threat. Meanwhile, in the "Before Times," journalist Helen Drew and Congressman Daniel Keene uncover a conspiracy that pulls them into a chain of events with catastrophic, irreversible consequences.

seasons.description: Marvel's best animated series returns with stunning action, high stakes, and perfect retro vibes.
seasons.overview: Season 2 continues with the heroic mutant team of X-Men, divided and thrown across different eras in time as they struggle to navigate their return home. Meanwhile, back in the 1990s, suspicious foes and new strains of mutant intolerance are on the rise in the wake of the X-Men's absence.

seasons.description: A massive, action-packed summer hit that delivers phenomenal fight scenes and hilarious comedy.
seasons.overview:
오직 자신의 딸 '민지'를 위해 특수요원직을 관두고 평범함을 선택한 가장 김부장.
그러던 어느 날 민지가 소리소문 없이 사라지고, 김부장은 자신을 감시하는 국가를 적으로 돌리면서까지 딸을 찾아나서기 시작하는데...

seasons.description: This record-shattering neo-Western is the biggest, most-watched new show on television right now.
seasons.overview: Beth Dutton and Rip Wheeler are striking out on their own, and relocating for a new adventure. Their ward, Carter, is along for the ride, and – despite serious distractions – Beth and Rip work hard to ensure he becomes the man he’s meant to be. Just after the events of the Yellowstone series finale, follow Beth and Rip as they take on a 7,000-acre ranch in South Texas. Even with all of its beautiful landscapes and peaceful lifestyle, the pair run into hiccups trying to survive in the area, including a ruthless rival ranch run by a wealthy owner.

seasons.description: Nicolas Cage plays a 1930s detective in a gorgeous, hard-boiled superhero show.
seasons.overview: Private investigator Ben Reilly is hired on a couple of straightforward cases... until mobsters, monsters, and a mysterious femme fatale spin a web that brings him face to face with his former life as New York's only superhero: The Spider.

seasons.description: Colin Farrell's stylishly bizarre, film-buff detective is back in Los Angeles for another mystery.
seasons.overview: Season two ushers in the return of Los Angeles' iconic private detective and film connoisseur, John Sugar, in a new case, tracking the troubled older brother of an up-and-coming local boxer, as his search for his beloved missing sister continues. As the investigation expands into a citywide conspiracy with sinister intentions, Sugar must reckon with himself to answer the question — how far will he go to do what's right?

seasons.description: The 90s-infused high school prequel to a classic comedy that everyone's bingeing on Prime.
seasons.overview: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

seasons.description: Another addictive, fast-paced Harlan Coben mystery that is currently dominating the Netflix charts.
seasons.overview: An innocent father serves a life sentence for the murder of his own son. When he receives evidence that his son my still be alive, he is determined to break out of prison to discover the truth.

seasons.description: The sci-fi animation giant wrapped up its latest run of chaotic, human-made comedy.
seasons.overview: Season 9 is all certified bangers. No AI slop! Just Grade A organic slop, made by real humans with real human traits like back hair and cysts. Please watch, or we'll have neglected our families for nothing.

seasons.description: TikTok's favorite romance novel comes to life in this incredibly steamy, R-rated college drama.
seasons.overview: The series depicts the elite ice hockey team, and the women in their lives, as they grapple with love, heartbreak, and self-discovery — forging deep friendships and enduring bonds while navigating the complexities that come with transitioning into adulthood.

seasons.description: The penultimate season of this terrifying mystery has Reddit working overtime on fan theories.
seasons.overview: The closer the town residents get to the answers they seek, the more terrifying their search becomes. Who is the Man in Yellow, and what does he want? Will Jade and Tabitha’s revelation be the key to finally going home? How much longer can Boyd hold the town together, even as his body and mind are falling apart? And what role will the town’s most recent arrival play in the events to come? Season Four will open doors that some in town will end up wishing had remained closed.

seasons.description: Lucasfilm's darkest, most beautifully animated series ever—a dream come true for prequel fans.
seasons.overview: Set after the events of "The Clone Wars," Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire. There, he crosses paths with a disillusioned young Jedi Padawan, who could be the apprentice he is seeking, that will aid him in his relentless pursuit for revenge.

seasons.description: This incredibly powerful coming-of-age sequel features phenomenal, award-worthy lead performances.
seasons.overview: Four years after the events of The Handmaid's Tale, a new generation of young women in Gilead grapple with the bleak future that awaits them. For these young women, growing up in Gilead is all they have ever known, having no tangible memories of the outside world prior to their indoctrination into this life. Facing the prospect of being married off and living a life of servitude, they will be forced to search for allies, both new and old, to help in their fight for freedom and the life they deserve.

seasons.description: A brilliantly quirky, darkly comical folk-horror mystery starring the fantastic Matthew Rhys.
seasons.overview: Widow's Bay is a quaint island town 40 miles off the coast of New England. But something lurks beneath the surface. Mayor Tom Loftis is desperate to revive his struggling community. There's no Wi-Fi, spotty cellular reception and he must contend with superstitious locals who believe their island is cursed. He wants these people to respect him. They don't. They think he is soft and cowardly. And he is. But Loftis is determined to build a better future for his teenage son and turn the island into a tourist destination. Miraculously, he succeeds: tourists are finally coming. Unfortunately, the locals were right. After decades of calm, the old stories that seemed too ludicrous to be true start happening again.

seasons.description: A sharp, savage Silicon Valley satire from a writer of Succession—pure black-comedy gold.
seasons.overview: A scandal is sparked by the exploitation of personal data which unravels out of a rift between a self-appointed "inventor of the future" tech CEO and his self-serving "performance psychologist." This act of corruption quickly spirals out of control for all involved, exposing the absurdities of ambition, corporate ethics, and the fallibility of the people who are shaping the future of our world.

seasons.description: Matthew Macfadyen and Elizabeth Banks excel in this surreal, bizarrely funny marital comedy.
seasons.overview: A married couple battle for power within their relationship which is complicated when an accident shrinks the wife to six inches tall.

seasons.description: Tatiana Maslany anchors this chaotic, anxiety-inducing thriller about cam culture and murder.
seasons.overview: A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder and youth soccer.

seasons.description: A tense, well-crafted Dutch conspiracy thriller focusing on high-stakes white-collar crime.
seasons.overview: Sylvia van Maele, officier van justitie in Den Haag, bundelt haar krachten met Lars van de FIOD in de strijd tegen financiële misdaad: een schaduwwereld vol brievenbusfirma's, doodlopende paper trails en internationale belastingregels die gebogen en gebroken worden. Wanneer de grens tussen haar persoonlijke en professionele leven vervaagt, moet Sylvia op haar intuïtie vertrouwen om te overleven.

seasons.description: The long-running procedural staple returns with more unsettling cases and classic tension.
seasons.overview: As the BAU investigates a string of chilling new cases, Elias Voit embarks on a path to atone for his past. His newfound infamy inadvertently awakens their most formidable nemesis yet, The Fan. Precise, calculating, and relentlessly dangerous, this UnSub pushes the BAU to the brink and back under the shadow of Elias Voit. But how far will The Fan go to prove his superiority over his idol?

seasons.series_name: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
seasons.description: A quirky historical comedy series that offers plenty of eccentric, offbeat laughs.
A lighthearted, easy-to-watch crime-comedy that makes for a perfect weekend binge-watch.
seasons.overview: Blackmailed into working for gangsters, two deeply incapable siblings become the most disorganized duo in organized crime.

seasons.description: Keep the kids entertained tonight with more adorable, action-packed heroic pup adventures.
seasons.overview: The PAW Patrol is on a roll with adventures that take the pups from the prehistoric wilds of Dino Island to the rock-climbing heights of Rescue Mountain. Along the way, they’ll team up with new friends–from a speedy racing pooch to the legendary Abominable Snow Pup–proving that for this team, no job is too big, no pup is too small!

seasons.description: The legendary animated comfort food is back with even more wacky, nautical nonsense.
seasons.overview: The misadventures of a talking sea sponge who works at a fast food restaurant, attends a boating school, and lives in an underwater pineapple.
